_meta.purpose: Demand-side data for poster concepts. Split by MARKET first (decor vs collector) - the two need opposite strategies. `search_grammar` shows how buyers in each market actually type.

search_grammar.decor: [colour] + [style] + [subject] + [format] + [room]  e.g. 'sage green botanical line art set of 3 bedroom'
search_grammar.collector: [subject] + [style] + [mood]  e.g. 'minimalist japanese red moon metal poster'

_meta.volume_note: Monthly search volumes are Etsy-side estimates for the US market, reported early 2026. Treat as relative magnitudes, re-verify before a batch.

niches.name: Abstract & Geometric
niches.audience: Renters and homeowners furnishing a neutral modern interior
niches.set_behaviour: STRONG - sell as set of 3 sharing one palette
niches.notes: Highest raw volume in printable wall art. Win on palette specificity, not on originality of form.

niches.name: Minimalist Quote & Typographic
niches.audience: Impulse buyers; lowest price point, fastest conversion
niches.ip_risk: R1 - quotes may be under copyright and phrases may be registered. Use original or clearly public-domain wording.
niches.notes: Converts fastest of any wall-art category because of the low price point. Treat as a volume-and-margin play, not a differentiation play.

niches.name: Botanical & Plants
niches.audience: Broad; the most durable evergreen in wall art
niches.set_behaviour: VERY STRONG - the native set-of-3 category
niches.ip_risk: R0 - antique botanical plates (Redouté, Audubon, Haeckel) are public domain; verify the scan's own rights
niches.notes: Monstera, fern, eucalyptus, mushroom, citrus branch, seed pod. Mushrooms in particular bridge into cottagecore demand.

niches.name: Boho & Earthy Tone
niches.audience: Decorators following the neutral/earthy interiors trend

niches.name: Vintage Travel & Place
niches.audience: Travellers, expats, gift buyers marking a trip
niches.set_behaviour: STRONG - a series of places in one identical treatment
niches.ip_risk: R1 - never use current tourism-board logos, NPS arrowhead, airline marks, or city brand identities
niches.notes: The single best 'one style, many subjects' engine in the poster catalogue: build one WPA treatment, apply to 60 places. Genuinely different subjects, so it does not trip duplicate detection.

niches.name: Nature & Landscape
niches.audience: Broad; strong on Displate as well as Etsy
niches.notes: Sunrise, sunset, green landscapes and mountains are the reported top-performing images.

niches.name: Japanese & Asian Aesthetic
niches.audience: Japandi decorators plus collectors; a named Displate category
niches.ip_risk: R0 for the aesthetic; R4 for any anime franchise, character or studio name
niches.notes: 'Red Moon Japan' and 'Cherry Blossom Japan' both charted in Displate's 2025 top 25 as ORIGINAL work. This is the strongest proven non-licensed collector lane.

niches.name: Space & Sci-Fi
niches.set_behaviour: STRONG - planets, missions, or moons as a series
niches.ip_risk: R0 for original; R4 for any film or game franchise
niches.notes: NASA imagery is generally public domain but the NASA insignia and wordmark are protected marks - do not use them.

niches.name: Celestial, Zodiac & Moon
niches.audience: Astrology-interested buyers; a strong Redbubble niche
niches.set_behaviour: VERY STRONG - 12 signs, 8 moon phases, 4 seasons
niches.notes: Built-in series structure. Twelve zodiac signs in one treatment is twelve genuinely distinct listings.

niches.name: Cottagecore & Whimsical
niches.audience: Younger decorators; very strong on Redbubble
niches.notes: Stack the aesthetic with a specific motif: 'cottagecore mushroom foraging', 'cottagecore hen', not 'cottagecore'.

niches.name: Dark Academia & Gothic
niches.audience: Students and young adults; a top Redbubble aesthetic
niches.ip_risk: R0 for the aesthetic; R4 for any named wizarding or literary franchise
niches.warning: Displate rejects very dark overall compositions. Keep a clear luminance range for that platform.

niches.name: Animals x Aesthetic
niches.notes: The stacking rule: breed or species x aesthetic x consistent treatment. 'Watercolour axolotl', 'dark academia black cat', 'linocut hare'. Rarer animals face far thinner competition.

niches.name: Humour & Character
niches.audience: Dorm, office, game-room and bar decorators
niches.notes: 'Judgmental Duck' was Displate's #1 original design of 2025. One animal, deadpan expression, direct eye contact, flat background. Reproducible formula, thin competition.

niches.name: Y2K & 2000s Nostalgia
niches.audience: Gen Z dorm and bedroom decorators; Redbubble-native
niches.ip_risk: R1 - no real OS chrome, logos, or brand marks

niches.name: Architecture & Cities
niches.set_behaviour: VERY STRONG - a city or building series in one treatment
niches.ip_risk: R1 - some modern buildings carry architectural copyright and trade dress; prefer historic structures

niches.name: Kitchen, Food & Drink
niches.audience: Home decorators, plus gifting for cooks and coffee people
niches.set_behaviour: VERY STRONG - herb series, coffee-method series, citrus series
niches.ip_risk: R1 - never real food or drink brands

niches.name: Dorm & Student Room
niches.set_behaviour: STRONG - collage walls mean multi-print purchases
niches.seasonal: Loads Jul-Sep for the back-to-school window. Load by early July.

niches.name: Fashion & Glamour
niches.ip_risk: R4 for any fashion house name, logo, monogram, perfume bottle silhouette or trade dress. This niche is a common source of takedowns - be strict.

niches.name: Outdoors & Adventure
niches.set_behaviour: VERY STRONG - a trail, peak or park series
niches.ip_risk: R1 - no NPS arrowhead, no gear brand marks
